svg.title: diopside current AWS architecture
svg.desc: Repository-aligned AWS architecture showing static public delivery, IAM operator control, asynchronous Lambda processing, observability, and known deployment gaps.
svg.text: 2026-08-01 — repository / CDK / runtime view. This does not mean deployed or production-accepted.
DEC-DB-001: S3 = data body / public artifacts; DynamoDB = small control state; Aurora DSQL is not adopted.
Known runtime blockers are registered below; solid lines show intended current CDK/runtime relationships, not successful AWS execution.
4. Observability, cost, and open deployment gaps

g.text: Lambda package · Processor raw write · S3 versions/lifecycle
SQS visibility/batch · Admin setup — GAP-ARCH-001 child gaps

svg.text: Legend: solid arrow = current CDK/runtime relationship · red dashed = missing path or unresolved production blocker · green = storage · orange = compute/queue · blue = control/observability · magenta = external/integration
